PRV-011.reason: The fixture adapter declares supports_point_in_time=true; a provider without historical PIT capability is outside this adapter's contract.

PRV-012.reason: The fixture retains raw input only as a test file; it has no persisted audit record that can retain the original local timestamp and value alongside the normalized output.

PRV-014.reason: The fixture adapter never writes through a repository, so it cannot prove transactional idempotency after a successful write and a lost response.

PRV-016.reason: The fixture cursor is stateless and this vertical slice has no committed watermark store from which to recover after expiry.
